notes.note: All 859 actual source units inventoried before source review. Original flat-array refs, chapter values, anchors and wording are retained; Greek/Septuagint chapter divisions remain authoritative. No missing units are invented and inventory/import adds no completed review credit.

Complete first curated pass of50 actual source units after the full859-unit Leviticus inventory. Original source references and anchors remain untouched. This is a cross-reference review and does not revise Scripture or claim exhaustive discovery.

Whole burnt offerings and sacrifices of deliverance remain distinct. Preserve male-only whole-offering eligibility beside male-or-female deliverance eligibility, singular hand beside plural hands, and different named participants and blood locations.

Retain turtledoves/pigeons, crop with feathers, east ash-place disposal, head-on-altar and draining-base wording. Poverty and childbirth alternatives retain their own bird numbers, conditions and purposes.

Preserve fine flour, oil, frankincense, oven/griddle/hearth preparations and memorial/remainder distinctions. The sin-flour gift excludes oil/frankincense; the priestly griddle gift is wholly burned and not eaten. No ordinary-remnant rule is imposed upon that priestly case.

Keep the prohibition of leaven/honey as altar offerings beside the permitted firstfruits presentation and the festival leavened loaves. Salt-covenant comparisons retain the separate priest-family and Davidic royal grants. Roasted/crushed groats are not renamed fine flour.

Retain belly fat, kidneys, liver lobe, unblemished loin and lower-back-muscle wording, as well as the different cattle/lamb/goat cases. Do not add a food-for-God formula absent from these Saints verses. Blood rationale retains the source claim that flesh's life is its blood, without new medical, original-language or specialist assertions.

Preserve anointed-high-priest sin so that the people sin, the communal ignorance and knowledge clauses, ruler male goat, ordinary-person female goat and female sheep alternatives. No independent diagnosis or new original-language distinction is added to unintended/unknown wording.

The priest/congregation calf blood enters the tent with veil-side sprinkling and incense-altar horns before pouring at the offering-altar base. The ruler and individual goat/sheep cases name offering-altar horns and base. Leviticus16 and Hebrews9 retain their annual settings and other locations.

Deliverance-offering comparisons preserve the particular calf, goat and sheep fat/organ lists, including the supplied sheep loin/lower-back wording. Outside-camp burning and Hebrews13's later Jesus application remain distinct from the other sin-offering portions and priestly shares.

Witness silence, oath hearing, animal and human uncleanness, awareness, sworn words and confession remain separate stated conditions. Proverbs29:24's sentence continues in25; that full context was read. FirstJohn's confession language is labelled later instruction, not an identical offering rule.

Keep flock/bird/flour means-based alternatives, bird sin-first and whole-burnt-second sequence, distinct head and blood procedures, tenth of an oiphi, excluded oil/frankincense and the priestly remainder. Childbirth and Luke's bird-pair references keep their own occasion; no new household-income determination is made.

Holy-things wrong, general unknowing forbidden act and civil property false-dealing remain separate cases. Preserve valued unblemished rams, restitution plus a fifth, priest versus wronged-party recipients and original5:21-26 divisions. Exodus double-repayment and Numbers absence-of-kin provisions retain their different actors and conditions.

notes: Exact source divisions preserved: Leviticus6 has23 units,7 has38,8 has36. The familiar alternative numbering is not substituted.
Same-chapter introductory speech links identify their actual following commands, audiences, and literary functions, beyond shared generic speech formulas.
Exodus28:29-30 resolves through the actual ordered28:29a unit. Exodus40:12-16 resolves its actual source units. No absent conventional verses were invented.
Differences in priestly actors, offerings, quantities, blood locations, garment handling, food eligibility, disposal times, and occasions are stated where material.
No source units in the assigned packet remain without a retained relation.

Five peer-requested wording corrections preserve the two7:12 target bread formulations,7:10 oil distinction,7:20 action/scope distinction, and8:21 belly/entrails wording. No pair additions or removals.

notes.note: Keep the seventh-to-eighth-day sequence, distinct calf/ram/goat/lamb offerings, priest and household versus congregation, horns/base versus surrounding altar blood actions, outside-camp flesh/hide, washed belly/feet, added sacrifice apart from the morning rite, and breast/right-foreleg shares. No inner-sanctuary blood action is inserted.
Compare the fire consuming commanded altar gifts with the fire consuming the two priests after uncommanded strange fire. No precise fire source, psychological state, or unstated cause is supplied.

Preserve Misadai and Elzaphan as supplied. Exodus 6 establishes Elzaphan/Uzziel/Amram/Aaron kinship but does not name Misadai. The mourning restrictions here address Aaron and his surviving sons; the later Leviticus 21 parallel is specifically the high priest.

Abstinence is tied to entry or altar approach, and the teaching charge includes holy/profane and clean/unclean distinctions. The most-holy unleavened remainder and the breast/foreleg household portion retain their own eaters, locations and entitlement rules. Leviticus 10:14 says holy place in this edition.

The goat dispute turns on the absence of blood brought into the holy place, priestly eating and atonement, followed by Aaron's particular response and Moses' acceptance. Do not turn the narrative response into an unstated general bereavement rule.

Preserve the exact English animal names and grouping, including choirogryllios, gryps, purple waterbird, brouchos, attakes, snake-fighter and land crocodile. Overlapping Deuteronomy bird names are compared without new zoological identities. The stated leaping-legged permission is retained beside the four-footed winged-creeping prohibitions.

Differentiate touch and carrying, garments and bodily bathing, contact with dead rather than living named creatures, dipped work articles, broken earthenware interiors, demolished ovens/pot-stands, clean water sources, sowing seed and moistened seed. Chapter 11:40 explicitly puts bathing in the carrying clause; chapter 17:15 requires bathing for the eater.

Later Mark, Acts and First Peter connections retain their own stated setting and scope. Acts 10:27-35 was read as context, including Peter's application to people. These are textual comparisons, with no contemporary medical or dietary advice and no new Greek, Hebrew, critical-apparatus, or human-specialist verification claims.

Initial curated pass covers all 124 actual units, including introductory speech units and units without a retained cross-reference. Source references and original anchors remain unchanged; 151 retained pairs do not imply exhaustive discovery.

Preserve male/female periods, eighth-day circumcision, the standard lamb and bird gift, and the means-dependent two-bird gift. Do not infer that every childbirth case uses the reduced-cost alternative.

Keep shifted and spread wording distinct. Retain the combinations of hair color, relative depth, faintness, stability and living-skin findings; no single color is generalized into a diagnosis or unconditional clean/unclean rule.
The supplied burn sequence says leprosy blossomed in the ulcer. That wording is retained and explicitly acknowledged in the comparison rather than silently changed to burn.

Keep bodily lesions, garment/leather lesions and house lesions separate, with their different isolation, washing, excision, burning, demolition, disposal and restoration conditions. No new disease or material identification is asserted.

Preserve clean living birds, cedarwood, spun scarlet thread, hyssop, living water, kotyle of oil, right earlobe and right-hand/right-foot extremities. Standard, poverty and house procedures are compared with their distinct materials and recipients retained.

The pinned English says the lesion has not spread before the following stone-removal instructions. That condition is preserved and distinguished from the no-spread finding after plastering in 14:48; no familiar edition is substituted.
Retain the supplied Psalm numbering and its actual future-language wording in the hyssop comparison.

Preserve the supplied seminal-discharge, stopped-up-flow, menstrual and prolonged-flow wording without a new diagnosis. Distinguish direct and indirect contact, touching versus carrying, washed-hand condition, named furniture/materials, bathing, evening limits and seven/eighth-day transitions.

Earthenware, wood and the compared bronze have different rules and triggers. Two birds for flow cleansing retain their own condition beside means-based sin or childbirth/leprosy alternatives. Narrative holy-bread and night-discharge camp settings remain distinct.

Childbirth menstrual comparisons, intercourse prohibitions, later blood-flow healing narratives and the tent-defilement warning retain their respective conditions and voices. Numbers19:13 is described with its actual wiped-out-from-Israel consequence, without independently defining its mechanism.

Preserve the sons' strange-fire antecedent, within-veil entry, linen vesting, own/household versus communal offerings, two distinct goat lots, incense vapour and divine-cloud wording, and on-cover eastward action followed by seven sprinklings before the cover. Altar and veil comparisons retain their stated locations.

Living-goat confession and removal, clothing change, fat on altar versus bodies burned outside camp, handler washing and distinct evening notices remain separate stages. Preserve the seventh-month tenth-day statute, native/resident scope, succession and annual frequency. Hebrews' own-blood and once-for-all comparisons remain later interpretation; its daily wording is not substituted for this annual rite.
